name: app-pink-performance-chart-phone-in-black-hands-floating-cards
title: Pink Performance Chart in Black Hands
whatItIs: A pastel pink and lilac cover with black hands holding a phone showing a performance chart of pink and blue bars, with floating portrait tiles and a '+56% lessons this week' card, and logo chips.
whatItMeans: Floating people and stat cards make data feel social and encouraging, and the black hands give strong contrast.
techniques: Floating portrait tiles and stat cards around the phone
Blurred bottom fade into the background
Pink line-and-bar chart as the main graphic
Black hands as the darkest element
Year pill and logo chips as cover metadata

vocabulary.definition: A statistic card floating outside the device.
A rounded photo square used as an avatar or testimonial.
A blur fade at the base of an image.
